name: Katherine Wiese
source:
The Keeper of [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Elysium_(VTM)]Elysium[/url] at the [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Art_Hole]Art Hole[/url] has been an important persona in NYC since at least the early 2000s. 

Wiese is a rather mysterious figure who rarely appears among other [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Kindred_(VTM)]Kindred[/url], but when she does, it's usually for a memorable occasion. 

She covers the lower part of her face due to some kind of accident from before her [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Embrace_(VTM)]Embrace[/url], and she typically finds any questions on this topic to be tasteless. 

These nights, her custody of the Elysium is mostly in name only, but her status as a well connected and relatively well liked socialite helps maintain her position.

[From the [Url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1405990/Vampire_The_Masquerade__Shadows_of_New_York_Artbook]Artbook[/url]]
